flavor: The floor of this chamber is a seamless expanse of fine, grey dust that ripples like water under the torchlight. A single, unblemished stone pillar stands in the center, casting a long, lonely shadow across the featureless ground.
name: The Sinking Silt-Pit
reason: The floor is a deceptive layer of loose, aerated soil covering a deep, hollow cavity; once weight is applied, the ground liquefies, pulling the victim into a crushing descent.
